goals.title: Build Eidolon into a safe local AI assistant
goals.description: Continue developing Eidolon with memory, tools, review, approved edits, rollback, testing, supervised self-improvement, maintenance suggestions, memory compaction, structured goals, and session planning.
next_actions: Keep powerful actions permission-gated and logged.
notes: Seed goal created by v1.8 Goal Manager.

goals.title: Keep Eidolon memory useful and compact
goals.description: Use memory status, compaction, summaries, and semantic rebuilds to keep long-term continuity manageable.

goals.title: Build a session planner from goals and project state
goals.description: Create a future workflow that combines goals, maintenance scans, memory summaries, and test reports into a recommended next safe task.

goals.title: Build task queue from session plans
goals.description: Create a future workflow that turns advisory session plan recommendations into an ordered, approval-based task queue without executing tasks automatically.
next_actions: Design task_queue.py after session planner is tested.

goals.title: Build background watch mode
goals.description: Add a bounded periodic scanner that creates diagnostics, maintenance/session suggestions, and watch reports without applying changes automatically.
notes: Completed by v3.0 Background Watch Mode.
